bio_en: Onnik Dertsakian, known as Arshak Vramian and by the party names Vahap and Varaz-Vahan, was born in Constantinople in 1870 and joined the ARF through Yusufian in 1894, entering the Constantinople Central Committee in 1895. Arrested after the demonstrations, he escaped from prison to the Russian embassy, avoiding a death sentence from a Turkish court-martial. In 1897 he toured the Armenian communities of Bulgaria and Romania as a party propagandist, and from 1898 worked in Geneva on Droshak; he later attended the 1909 Varna General Congress and worked in Van, where in 1915 he and Aram negotiated with the governor. He was killed in 1915.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Circumstances of his death (Van, April 1915) not read in detail; Ottoman deputy role is general knowledge - verify.
